# Singapore Section of the Combustion Institute (SSCI)

> The Singapore Section of the Combustion Institute (SSCI), established in 2024, fosters and promotes research in combustion science in Singapore and beyond, with a focus on science and technology for decarbonization and sustainability. It is a section of The Combustion Institute (https://www.combustioninstitute.org/). Contact: office@ssci-combustion.org

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.ssci-combustion.org/): overview, latest SSCI event, and latest news and events from The Combustion Institute
- [About](https://www.ssci-combustion.org/about.html): executive board, committee members, honorary life members and the section bylaws
- [Annual Meetings](https://www.ssci-combustion.org/annual-meetings.html): the 1st (9 December 2025) and 2nd (16 November 2026) SSCI Annual Combustion Meetings
- [Webinars](https://www.ssci-combustion.org/webinars.html): SSCI Young Combustion Researchers Webinar Series
- [Other Events](https://www.ssci-combustion.org/events.html): related conferences and workshops
- [Membership](https://www.ssci-combustion.org/membership.html): benefits, fees and how to join
- [Young Investigator Award](https://www.ssci-combustion.org/young-investigator-award.html): award description, 2026 recipients and selection panel
- [Young Researcher Exchange Programme](https://www.ssci-combustion.org/collaboration.html): collaboration programme with neighbouring Sections of The Combustion Institute
- [Contact](https://www.ssci-combustion.org/contacts.html): office email, LinkedIn and The Combustion Institute
